subject.title: feat: add publisher feed query and delta state

question: Should ClawHub adopt the RFC 0009 publisher query/delta state now, and what landing order should govern the open foundation, signing, delta, and signed-route PRs?
rationale: The branch creates durable protocol state and API/schema vocabulary, while its own body identifies unresolved open dependencies and a future child integration; code review cannot safely choose that permanent product contract or stack order.

options.title: Approve a staged protocol
options.body: Confirm the RFC direction and require the foundation to land first, followed by this rebased delta layer and then the signed-route integration.

options.title: Defer publisher deltas
options.body: Pause this layer until the RFC and signing/distribution design are accepted, avoiding persistent state that may need incompatible revision.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only an internally useful storage primitive if maintainers want to avoid committing public query/change contract semantics now.

recommendation.title: Approve a staged protocol
recommendation.body: Confirm the RFC direction and require the foundation to land first, followed by this rebased delta layer and then the signed-route integration.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest available routing candidate from the publisher-identity and ownership review history referenced by the stacked foundation work.
